caption: The drawing depicts a circular scene bordered by a red and brown rim, with a ring of German text inscribed around the inner edge. At the center of the composition, there is a figure of a man riding a cream-colored horse. The man is dressed in a green coat, brown trousers, and a brown hat with a red trim, and he is holding a curved sword or saber in his right hand and a long, straight trumpet or horn to his mouth with his left hand. The horse is shown mid-gallop with its legs extended. Below and around the horse are stylized floral motifs with green leaves and red accents. The background within the circular border is a light tan or beige, while the area outside the circle is a plain off-white color. At the top inside the border, there is the year "1805" written in black. The drawing shows no additional objects outside the main circular scene.
title: Plate with Soldier on Horseback
